market_definition: The U.S. Entresto Market covers commercially marketed finished dosage formulations (FDFs) containing the fixed-dose combination of sacubitril and valsartan, including branded ENTRESTO and generic equivalents. These prescription medicines are used for the treatment of heart failure in adult and pediatric patients, subject to applicable approved indications. The market includes finished oral pharmaceutical products, such as film-coated tablets and oral pellets (sprinkle formulations), distributed through hospital pharmacies, retail pharmacies, and online pharmacies across the United States. Market sizing focuses exclusively on revenue generated from finished pharmaceutical formulations, excluding active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), bulk drug substances, and intermediates. Segmentation: by product type (Branded ENTRESTO, Generic Sacubitril/Valsartan); by dosage form / strength (Film-Coated Tablets 24/26 mg, 49/51 mg, 97/103 mg; Oral Pellets / Sprinkle Formulations 6/6 mg, 15/16 mg).
core_scope: A core player is HEADQUARTERED IN THE UNITED STATES (the U.S. operating company of a foreign group qualifies) and commercially markets, in the United States, a finished dosage formulation of sacubitril and valsartan: branded ENTRESTO or a generic equivalent (film-coated tablets or oral pellets / sprinkle formulations).
adjacent_segments: Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs): Bulk sacubitril, valsartan, and sacubitril/valsartan API combinations supplied for pharmaceutical manufacturing
Pharmaceutical Intermediates: Drug intermediates, raw materials, and unfinished or bulk pharmaceutical formulations that have not reached the finished dosage stage
Other Cardiovascular Medicines: Standalone valsartan products, other angiotensin receptor blockers (ARBs), ACE inhibitors, and unrelated heart failure medications
Non-Commercial and Development-Stage Products: Investigational formulations and unapproved sacubitril/valsartan products not commercially marketed in the United States
scope: ONLY companies HEADQUARTERED IN THE U.S. (the U.S. operating company of a foreign group qualifies) that commercially market in the U.S. finished dosage formulations of sacubitril/valsartan: branded ENTRESTO or generic equivalents (film-coated tablets 24/26, 49/51, 97/103 mg; oral pellets / sprinkles 6/6, 15/16 mg). NOT in this market: (1) APIs: bulk sacubitril, valsartan or sacubitril/valsartan API supplied for manufacturing; (2) intermediates, raw materials and unfinished or bulk formulations; (3) other cardiovascular medicines: standalone valsartan, other ARBs, ACE inhibitors, unrelated heart failure medications; (4) investigational formulations and unapproved sacubitril/valsartan products not commercially marketed in the U.S.
